info.title: RetailCrm Opus Product Assistant API
info.description:
## Overview
HTTP API for the RetailCrm Opus product assistant: phone OTP login, RAG chat (sync and SSE stream),
chat sessions, speech-to-text upload, per-message feedback, and the SFA "Know About Product" lookup.

## Authentication (Bearer JWT)
When the server sets **`API_JWT_SECRET`** and **`API_REQUIRE_JWT=true`**, these prefixes require the header
**`Authorization: Bearer`** followed by the `access_token` string from verify-otp: `/api/chat`, `/api/voice`, `/api/feedback`.

## Authentication (SFA API key)
`/api/v1/product/know-about-product` is separate from the JWT scheme above: it requires header
**`X-API-KEY`** (**`SFA_KNOW_PRODUCT_API_KEY`**) and, if **`SFA_ALLOWED_IPS`** is set, a whitelisted
source IP. Failures use `{"status":"FAILURE","errorCode":...,"message":...}`, not `{"detail":...}`.

- Obtain **`access_token`** from **`POST /api/auth/verify-otp`** (field is omitted if JWT is not configured).
- **`/api/auth/*`**, **`/health`**, **`/`**, **`/info`**, and OpenAPI paths are not JWT-gated.
- If JWT is required but the server has no secret, protected routes return **503** with a configuration message.

When JWT is optional but a valid Bearer token is sent, **`user_id` / `persona` from the token override**
query/body on chat session routes (see router docstrings).

## Typical client flow
1. **`POST /api/auth/request-otp`** with a whitelisted 10-digit phone.
2. **`POST /api/auth/verify-otp`** with phone + 6-digit OTP → store **`user_id`**, **`session_id`**, and **`access_token`** if present.
3. **`POST /api/chat/query`** or **`/api/chat/query/stream`** with JSON body; add Bearer header when enforced.
4. Optional: **`POST /api/voice/transcribe`** (multipart file), **`POST /api/feedback/{message_id}`**.

## QA — common HTTP status codes
| Code | Where | Meaning |
|------|--------|---------|
| **400** | Feedback | Invalid `rating` value |
| **401** | Auth / JWT | Bad OTP; missing or invalid Bearer when JWT required |
| **403** | Auth | Phone not whitelisted, inactive account, or OTP request throttled |
| **404** | Chat sessions | Unknown `session_id` |
| **413** | Voice | Audio larger than `VOICE_MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES` |
| **422** | Voice / Pydantic | Unprocessable audio or request validation failure |
| **429** | Global | Rate limit (`ENABLE_RATE_LIMIT=true`) |
| **500** | Any | Unexpected server error (generic message to client) |
| **503** | Voice / JWT | STT not configured; or JWT enforcement misconfigured |

## Configuration pointers
- **CORS**: `CORS_ORIGINS` (JSON array in env). Use explicit origins in production.
- **Rate limit**: `ENABLE_RATE_LIMIT`, `DEFAULT_RATE_LIMIT`.
- **Pipeline**: `GET /info` returns whether **router+composer** or **legacy** flow is active.

post.summary: Send OTP to a whitelisted phone
post.description:
Request OTP for a phone number.

The phone number's persona is determined from the MongoDB whitelisted_users collection.
Returns a one-time ``login_challenge`` that must be sent back on ``verify-otp``.

200.description: Success message when an OTP is generated and send is accepted.

post.summary: Verify OTP and return session profile
post.description:
Verify OTP and log in.

By default returns only ``{ok: true}`` and sets an HttpOnly auth cookie.
Call ``GET /api/auth/me`` with credentials to load user profile and session id.

200.description: Minimal login body; JWT in HttpOnly cookie (and optionally body).

post.summary: Rotate refresh token and mint a new access token
post.description: Issue a new short-lived access token using an HttpOnly refresh token cookie.

get.description:
Validate the current JWT (Bearer or HttpOnly cookie) and return profile from MongoDB.

Frontends should call this after OTP verify instead of storing profile data in localStorage.

post.summary: Logout and invalidate API tokens for this user
post.description: Invalidate this device's JWT and clear the auth cookie (other devices stay signed in).

post.summary: Run one product assistant turn (JSON response)
post.description:
Process a user query. Uses router+composer pipeline (product catalog, JSON, RAG) when `USE_ROUTER_COMPOSER=true`.
Runs blocking work in a thread pool so the event loop stays responsive under load.

**Body**: `query` (required), optional `session_id` for conversation memory.
**Query**: `user_id`, `persona` — JWT ``sub`` wins; persona follows profile when Bearer token is valid.
**Response**: see `QueryResponse` (answer markdown, citations, timings, `message_id` for feedback).

Server-Sent Events stream of the same pipeline as POST /query.

Events are JSON lines in SSE ``data:`` frames:
- ``{"type":"delta","text":"..."}`` — incremental answer text (raw model stream; may be temporarily invalid Markdown mid-stream).
- ``{"type":"final","payload":{...}}`` — same shape as non-streaming ``QueryResponse`` (response, citations, message_id, metadata, timings). Clients should treat ``payload["response"]`` as the canonical assistant markdown once received (replace or reconcile streamed content with this string for correct GFM rendering).
- ``{"type":"error","message":"..."}`` — unrecoverable failure in the worker thread.

Retrieval/routing runs before the first delta; time-to-first-token is lower than waiting for the full JSON body on ``/query``.

**429** (plain JSON, not SSE — raised before the stream opens) when the caller's daily token
quota (``DAILY_TOKEN_LIMIT``) is already used up; body shape matches ``POST /query``'s 429.

get.summary: List recent chat sessions for a user
get.description:
Return up to `limit` sessions ordered for this user (Mongo-backed).

`user_id` query is ignored for identity when a valid JWT supplies `sub`.

schema.title: Response Get Sessions Api Chat Sessions Get

post.summary: Create a new empty chat session
post.description:
Create a session row for the authenticated user (JWT ``sub`` when Bearer token is valid).

If ``user_id`` in the body differs from the JWT subject, returns **403** (not a silent override).
``persona`` in the body may be ``dealer`` or ``internal`` (need not match the JWT profile).

get.description:
Return messages for `session_id`, optionally capped to the last `limit_pairs` Q&A pairs.

**404** if the session does not exist. **403** if the session belongs to another user.
Assistant messages include `message_id` for `POST /api/feedback/{message_id}`.

parameters.name: limit_pairs

schema.description: Return at most the last N Q&A pairs (sliding window). Omit for full thread unless SESSION_API_MESSAGES_MAX_PAIRS is set.
schema.title: Limit Pairs

parameters.description: Return at most the last N Q&A pairs (sliding window). Omit for full thread unless SESSION_API_MESSAGES_MAX_PAIRS is set.

schema.title: Response Get Session Messages Api Chat Sessions  Session Id  Messages Get

patch.description: Set the session title. **404** if `session_id` is unknown. **403** if not the owner.

delete.description:
Soft-archive session (``is_active=false``); transcript remains readable via GET messages.

**404** if `session_id` is unknown. **403** if not the owner.

post.description: Persist ``rating`` for the assistant Q&A row identified by ``message_id``.

Transcribe uploaded audio (e.g. WebM/Opus from MediaRecorder) via configured STT provider.

Provider is selected via settings `VOICE_STT_PROVIDER`:
- google (default): Google Cloud Speech-to-Text
- deepgram: Deepgram STT (paid; supports multilingual detection)
- sarvam: Sarvam Saaras STT (REST)
- soniox: Soniox STT (REST)

200.description: JSON object with a single `transcript` string.

post.summary: Consolidated product knowledge for SFA (Product Info, Benefits, Competitor Details, Sales Pitch)
post.description:
Look up one product by code; return the 4 sections from the BFRD (v1.0, 09-Jul-2026).

Requires header ``X-API-KEY``, (if ``SFA_ALLOWED_IPS`` is configured) a whitelisted source IP,
and ``Authorization: Bearer <jwt>`` identifying the calling TSM — see ``require_sfa_api_access``.
**400** ``INVALID_PRODUCT_CODE`` for a missing/malformed code, **404** ``PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND`` if
it does not resolve in the product catalog.

get.description: Minimal JSON with API title, version, and running status. Suitable for smoke checks.
Kubernetes/load-balancer style liveness. Does not verify MongoDB, STT, or LLM backends.

Return which answer pipeline is active (**router_composer** vs **legacy_agent**) and a short description.

Use this after deploys to confirm `USE_ROUTER_COMPOSER` and related behavior without sending a chat query.

session_id.title: Session Id
session_id.description: Active chat session id for this user (from MongoDB).

AuthMeResponse.title: AuthMeResponse
AuthMeResponse.description: Authenticated user profile from server state (call after verify-otp; do not cache in localStorage).

competitorName.title: Competitorname
competitorName.description: Known competitor brand(s) mentioned in the KB answer, if any.

CompetitorDetail.title: CompetitorDetail
CompetitorDetail.description: One entry of the "Competitor Details" list.

user_id.title: User Id
user_id.description: User ID (must match JWT sub when authenticated)

persona.title: Persona
persona.description: Session persona: dealer or internal (may differ from profile; not required to match JWT)

message.title: Message
message.description: Human-readable result for clients and QA.

KnowAboutProductRequest.title: KnowAboutProductRequest
KnowAboutProductRequest.description:
SFA "Know About Product" lookup. Fields are optional here so a missing/malformed
``productCode`` produces the BFRD's 400 ``INVALID_PRODUCT_CODE`` envelope (via the route
handler) instead of a generic FastAPI 422.

KnowAboutProductResponse.title: KnowAboutProductResponse
KnowAboutProductResponse.description:
Response contract for ``POST /api/v1/product/know-about-product``.

Matches the BFRD "Know About Product API" (v1.0, 09-Jul-2026) sample response shape.

access_token.title: Access Token
access_token.description: Bearer JWT when API_AUTH_RETURN_TOKEN_IN_BODY=true; otherwise use HttpOnly auth cookie.

LoginResponse.title: LoginResponse
LoginResponse.description:
Successful OTP verification.

Default (``API_AUTH_MINIMAL_LOGIN_RESPONSE=true``): only ``ok`` (+ HttpOnly cookie).
Legacy mode includes profile fields — prefer ``GET /api/auth/me`` instead of persisting them client-side.

message_id.title: Message Id
message_id.description: Populated for assistant turns; use with `POST /api/feedback/{message_id}`.

MessageResponse.title: MessageResponse
MessageResponse.description: Single message in a transcript (`GET .../messages` returns an ordered list).

login_challenge.title: Login Challenge
login_challenge.description: One-time id to send on verify-otp; binds login to this OTP request.

OTPRequestResponse.title: OTPRequestResponse
OTPRequestResponse.description: OTP requested successfully; client must retain ``login_challenge`` for verify-otp.

login_challenge.title: Login Challenge
login_challenge.description: One-time value from POST /api/auth/request-otp; required when AUTH_REQUIRE_LOGIN_CHALLENGE is enabled.

benefitTitle.title: Benefittitle
benefitTitle.description: Short lead-in when the source bullet has one (e.g. bolded label); else empty.

ProductBenefit.title: ProductBenefit
ProductBenefit.description: One entry of the "Product Benefits" list.

description.title: Description
description.description: KB-grounded overview (router+composer answer for this product).

specifications.title: Specifications
specifications.description: Reserved for structured spec key/values; empty until a structured spec schema exists in the KB.

ProductInfoSection.title: ProductInfoSection
ProductInfoSection.description: "Product Info" section of the Know About Product API.

session_id.title: Session Id
session_id.description: Session ID (optional for single-query; required for follow-ups)

retrieval_time_ms.title: Retrieval Time Ms
retrieval_time_ms.description: Wall-clock ms for the router retrieval phase: session-backed context merge, parallel product resolution / intent refinement, route() (catalog + RAG + JSON store), and compose(). Excludes the main answer LLM. For vector/SQL index latency only, see qdrant_vector_query_time_ms and sqlite_index_query_time_ms.

llm_time_ms.title: Llm Time Ms
llm_time_ms.description: Wall-clock ms for the main answer LLM call (generate/stream through completion). 0 when served from cache, composer-only, or fixed responses.

total_time_ms.title: Total Time Ms
total_time_ms.description: Wall-clock ms for the full server-side query handler (same perf_counter origin as stream_time_to_first_chunk_ms): load, routing, generation, persistence.

qdrant_vector_query_time_ms.title: Qdrant Vector Query Time Ms
qdrant_vector_query_time_ms.description: Sum of wall-clock ms spent inside Qdrant client query_points calls for this request (0 if none ran).

sqlite_index_query_time_ms.title: Sqlite Index Query Time Ms
sqlite_index_query_time_ms.description: Sum of wall-clock ms spent executing SQL on the KB JSON SQLite index (json_store) for this request (0 if none ran).

stream_time_to_first_chunk_ms.title: Stream Time To First Chunk Ms
stream_time_to_first_chunk_ms.description: Streaming: ms from the same server-side start as total_time_ms until the first non-empty model text delta. If there was no streamed delta, set to max(0, total_time_ms - llm_time_ms) so clients always get a number (approx. pre-main-LLM wall); not identical to true TTFT in that case.

QueryResponse.title: QueryResponse
QueryResponse.description: Non-streaming chat response: answer text, citations, ids, and optional timings.

SalesPitchSection.title: SalesPitchSection
SalesPitchSection.description: "Sales Pitch (How to Sell)" section of the Know About Product API.

id.title: Id
id.description: Session id; send as `session_id` on chat requests for threading.

SessionResponse.title: SessionResponse
SessionResponse.description: One chat session row as returned by list/create session APIs.

tags.name: meta
tags.description: Service metadata: root banner, health probe, pipeline info. No authentication required.

tags.name: auth
tags.description: Phone-based OTP login. Persona and display name come from MongoDB `whitelisted_users`. After `verify-otp`, persist `user_id` and optional `access_token` for subsequent API calls.

tags.name: chat
tags.description: Product Q&A (`/query`, `/query/stream`) and session CRUD. Use `session_id` from the body for threaded follow-ups. When a JWT is present, effective user/persona may be taken from the token (see app description).

tags.name: voice
tags.description: Speech-to-text: upload audio (e.g. WebM from `MediaRecorder`). Provider is `VOICE_STT_PROVIDER` (google, deepgram, sarvam, soniox). Expect **422** for corrupt/too-small audio, **503** if STT is not configured.

tags.name: feedback
tags.description: Submit helpful / not_helpful for an assistant turn. `message_id` is the identifier returned on chat responses (assistant message).

tags.name: sfa-integration
tags.description: Know About Product API for the Sales Force Automation (SFA) platform: consolidated Product Info, Benefits, Competitor Details, and Sales Pitch by product code. Requires header `X-API-KEY`; optionally restricted to whitelisted IPs (`SFA_KNOW_PRODUCT_API_KEY` / `SFA_ALLOWED_IPS`). Error body shape differs from the rest of this API: `{"status":"FAILURE","errorCode":...,"message":...}`.
